row.evidence: CreatorIQ publishes no plans or prices ('Schedule a call with one of our Platform Specialists who will: Give you more information on our pricing and packages'). Its trust page mentions SAML single sign-on, but no public page documents SCIM.
row.notes: Quote-only: www.creatoriq.com/pricing redirects to a pricing-request form. The trust page says CreatorIQ encourages SAML single sign-on, with no plan named. The help centre (support.creatoriq.com, Zendesk) needs a login: pages return HTTP 403 and the article search API answers 'Couldn't authenticate you'. So SCIM and provisioning docs could not be searched, and the status stays unknown rather than none. The public API portal (apidocs.creatoriq.com, Stoplight) documents CRM, campaign, reporting, payments and webhook APIs. Its 'CRM partner Users API' spec defines a response schema listing recruits, managers and administrators, but publishes no paths. No user-management endpoints are documented. CreatorIQ is not in the Okta Integration Network.

plans.name: Custom (quote only)
plans.notes: No public tier table. Pricing comes from a call with a Platform Specialist.

scim.notes: No public SCIM documentation. The help centre that may describe it requires a login.

user_api.notes: CreatorIQ's public REST API (ExchangeIQ, x-api-key header) covers creators, campaigns, lists, reports, link tracking, brand safety and payments. A 'CRM partner Users API' page exists, but its OpenAPI export has 'paths: {}' and only a response model of recruits, managers and administrators. Whether there is any user-management endpoint is unknown.

entra.notes: No CreatorIQ tutorial in Microsoft Learn's saas-apps table of contents. Gallery listing not verified.

fallbacks.notes: The help centre (support.creatoriq.com) needs a customer login. SAML SSO is mentioned on the trust page (c2), but JIT, CSV user import and directory sync are not documented publicly.
